card.name: Words signaling a co-occurring condition or drug
card.fires_on: Linking words and word parts that come right before a second condition or drug present at the same time, such as 'and' in 'HIV-1 and HBV', 'by' after 'confounded', and the pieces of 'concomitant', 'comorbid' and 'coexistent'.

modes.label: Co-infection linker
modes.description: The word 'and' joining two conditions a patient has together.
modes.example: patients with HIV-1<< and>> HBV who discontinue ODEFSE

modes.label: Confounded by other exposure
modes.description: The word 'by' after 'confounded', ahead of other substances taken at the same time.

modes.description: Middle pieces of words meaning present at the same time.
modes.example: and any concom<<itant>> medication or disease state.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning 'simultaneously' and 'concurrently', which pushes the model to continue with co-occurrence meaning.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to mention something else happening or present at the same time.
